gloss: way of doing things; methods (usually bad)

definitions.gloss: way of doing things; methods; tactics
definitions.explanation: The way someone goes about doing something, almost always said disapprovingly of methods that are unfair, sly or underhand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汚|きたな}い→汚い：00788_kitanai⟧やり{口|くち}だ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やり{口|くち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}せない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: I can't forgive the way that company operates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧だまして⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧やり{口|くち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Schemes that trick old people out of their money are on the rise.

notes:
Almost always negative: it points to the unfairness of the method. For a neutral 'way of doing', use ⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{汚|きたな}い→汚い：00788_kitanai⟧やり{口|くち}: dirty tactics
- ⟦{巧妙|こうみょう}→巧妙：07933_koumyou⟧なやり{口|くち}: a cunning method
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やり{口|くち}: the usual trick

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧: way of doing; neutral
- ⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧: the method of a crime, a modus operandi
